notes:
0.11.5.0
- The game now updates itself: new versions download only what changed.
- Intel / integrated graphics: a lighter compatibility mode turns on by itself (Options > Graphics > Compatibility).
- Guests: zombies move smoothly and shots hit what you see.
- Host lost: the game pauses, everyone reconnects, then 3-2-1-GO.
- Join requests: no spamming, a separate cancel and a cooldown after a deny.
- Tesla Marine: Bleached stacks, slower chain that Capacitor speeds up, extension passives working.
- Maps: no more containers and crates stuck inside each other.
